FROM customers c LEFT JOIN loyalty_accounts la ON la.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN reward_rules rr ON rr.id = coalesce(la.reward_rule_id, (SELECT id FROM reward_rules WHERE active)) WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.marketing_opt_out_at IS NULL AND c.phone_enc IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stamps s WHERE s.customer_id = c.id AND s.branch_id = #{a.branchId} AND s.status = 'CONFIRMED')
AND coalesce(c.last_visit_at, c.registered_at) < #{a.inactiveSince}
AND la.current_stamps > 0 AND la.current_stamps < rr.stamps_required AND la.current_stamps >= rr.stamps_required - 2
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rewards w WHERE w.customer_id = c.id AND w.status = 'AVAILABLE')
AND coalesce(la.current_stamps, 0) = 0
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches WHERE id = #{branchId})
SELECT stamps_required FROM reward_rules WHERE active
SELECT id FROM branches WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 1
SELECT c.name FROM campaign_recipients r JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaigns (id, type, stamp_count, text, personalized, latin, audience, inactive_days, branch_id, recipients, segments_per_message, total_sms, status, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{c.id}, #{c.type}, #{c.stampCount}, #{c.text}, #{c.personalized}, #{c.latin}, #{c.audience}, #{c.inactiveDays}, #{c.branchId}, #{c.recipients}, #{c.segmentsPerMessage}, #{c.totalSms}, #{c.status}, #{c.createdBy}, #{c.createdAt})
INSERT INTO campaign_recipients (campaign_id, customer_id, status) SELECT #{campaignId}, c.id, 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET stamp_count = #{stampCount}, text = #{text}, personalized = #{personalized}, latin = #{latin}, audience = #{audience}, inactive_days = #{inactiveDays}, branch_id = #{branchId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.type, c.stamp_count, c.text, c.personalized, c.latin, c.audience, c.inactive_days, c.branch_id, c.recipients, c.segments_per_message, c.total_sms, c.status, c.reject_reason, c.pause_reason, c.created_by, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.decided_at, c.deadline_at, c.finished_at, coalesce(n.sent, 0) AS sent_count, coalesce(n.failed, 0) AS failed_count, coalesce(n.pending, 0) AS pending_count, coalesce(n.skipped, 0) AS skipped_count, coalesce(n.stamped, 0) AS stamps_granted FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'SENT') AS sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING')) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status = 'SKIPPED') AS skipped, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.stamps_granted_at IS NOT NULL) AS stamped FROM campaign_recipients r WHERE r.campaign_id = c.id) n ON true
mapper.select: SELECT r.customer_id, c.name, c.phone_enc, r.error, r.sent_at AS at FROM campaign_recipients r JOIN customers c ON c.id = r.customer_id WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND r.status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY r.sent_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.customer_id
mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET status = #{to}, decided_at = coalesce(#{decidedAt}, decided_at), decided_by = coalesce(#{decidedBy}, decided_by), reject_reason = coalesce(#{rejectReason}, reject_reason) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM campaigns WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'SENDING') ORDER BY decided_at, id
mapper.update: UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'SENDING', deadline_at = #{deadlineAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'PAUSED', pause_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE campaigns SET status = 'SENDING', pause_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAUSED'

UPDATE campaign_recipients r SET status = 'SKIPPED' FROM customers c WHERE r.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND r.status = 'PENDING' AND c.id = r.customer_id AND (c.status <> 'ACTIVE' OR c.marketing_opt_out_at IS NOT NULL OR c.phone_enc IS NULL)
UPDATE campaign_recipients SET status = 'FAILED', sent_at = #{now}, error = coalesce(error || ' · ', '') || 'Son müddət bitdi' WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: UPDATE campaign_recipients r SET status = 'SENDING', claimed_at = #{now} FROM customers c WHERE c.id = r.customer_id AND (r.campaign_id, r.customer_id) IN ( SELECT campaign_id, customer_id FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY customer_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING r.customer_id, c.phone_enc, c.name, c.last_branch_id, r.attempts
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign_recipients SET status = 'PENDING' WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE campaign_recipients SET stamps_granted_at = #{now} WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND stamps_granted_at IS NULL

UPDATE campaigns c SET status = 'SENT', finished_at = #{now}, sent_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status = 'SENT'), failed_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status = 'FAILED') WHERE c.id = #{campaignId} AND c.status = 'SENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_recipients WHERE campaign_id = c.id AND status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING'))
